independent_computation.step_1_template_semantics: The League wiki template {{rd|A|B}} is a ranged-difference split: A is the value for a MELEE wielder, B for a RANGED wielder. Calibrated inside this same cache against four independently-known effects: Tiamat-family Cleave is 40% AD melee / 20% AD ranged; Titanic Hydra on-hit is 1% max HP melee / 0.5% ranged; Phage grants 20 MS melee / 10 ranged; Death's Dance stores 30% of damage melee / 10% ranged. In every case the FIRST argument is the melee value. Ordering is therefore melee-first, unambiguously.
independent_computation.step_2_read_the_effect: Bloodsong's Spellblade proc, when the empowered basic attack lands on a champion, applies 'Expose Weakness' for 4 seconds. Expose Weakness is a debuff ON THE TARGET that increases the damage it takes FROM ALL SOURCES — not only from the Bloodsong holder. So an ally carry attacking the debuffed champion is amplified too, which is exactly what a leaf named 'support_damage_multiplier' on a coupled (attacker + support ally) roster scenario should represent.
independent_computation.step_3_apply: increase = {{rd|8%|5%}} -> 8% if the Bloodsong holder is melee, 5% if ranged. 'Take X% increased damage' is a multiplicative amp on the damage instance, so the multiplier is 1 + X/100: melee -> 1 + 0.08 = 1.08; ranged -> 1 + 0.05 = 1.05.
independent_computation.step_4_admissible_set: {1.08 (melee holder), 1.05 (ranged holder)}. A value of 1.0 / absent is NOT admissible for an event that carries a Bloodsong Expose Weakness application — the cached text makes the debuff unconditional on a champion-target proc.
independent_computation.step_5_verdict_basis: The published new value 1.08 equals the melee branch exactly, with the correct 1 + X/100 sense and the correct 'all sources' scope (a support's debuff amplifying a different participant's damage). The old state, <absent>, corresponds to no amplification at all and contradicts the only source text available for this item.

residual_dependency.statement: 1.08 is correct if and only if the Bloodsong holder in the cleaver_bloodsong_roster support slot is a MELEE champion; a ranged holder would make the sourced value 1.05.
residual_dependency.why_unresolved_here: The roster composition for coupled_scenarios/cleaver_bloodsong_roster is defined outside the permitted evidence tree (scenario/golden definitions live under scripts/ and tests/, which this runbook forbids reading). data/ contains no scenario roster — grep for 'cleaver_bloodsong', 'coupled_scenarios', and 'roster' across the export returns no scenario definition.
residual_dependency.effect_on_verdict: It does not rescue the old state. <absent> is outside the admissible set under EITHER holder type, so the change is directionally required and the published value matches a verbatim branch of the cached formula. Verdict is new_value_correct; the melee/ranged branch selection is flagged as the one check an evidence-tree-restricted oracle cannot close, and should be confirmed against the scenario's support champion attack range.

checks_performed: Multiplier sense: 'increased damage' -> 1 + X, not 1 - X and not a resistance change. 1.08 has the correct sense.
Scope: 'from all sources' — a support-held debuff legitimately multiplies a different participant's damage, so a 'support_damage_multiplier' leaf is the right home for it.

Attribution: the source string 'Bloodsong — Expose Weakness' names the debuff, not the item's own 100% base AD on-hit component — those are separate rows of the same passive and must not be conflated.
Co-item cross-talk: Black Cleaver ('cleaver' in the scenario name) contributes armor REDUCTION, not a damage amplifier, so it cannot account for or contaminate a 1.08 multiplier leaf.
